# MaxViT and CoAtNet

**Category:** Hybrid · **Code:**
[`timm/models/maxxvit.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/maxxvit.py) ·
**Architectures:** 56 · **Pretrained weights:** 52 (43 with ImageNet-1k results)

From-scratch implementations of MaxViT (MBConv blocks with multi-axis attention, blocked local and dilated grid
attention) and CoAtNet (convolution stages followed by relative attention stages), plus `timm` variants (`_rw` configs,
MaxxViT).

## Papers

* [MaxViT: Multi-Axis Vision Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.01697)
* [CoAtNet: Marrying Convolution and Attention for All Data Sizes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.04803)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('maxxvitv2_nano_rw_256.sw_in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

## Model API support

| Feature | `MaxxVit` |
|---|---|
| [`features_only=True` feature maps](../model_api#intermediate-features) | ✓ (strides 2, 4, 8, 16, 32) |
| [`forward_intermediates()`](../model_api#intermediate-features) | ✓ |
| [`prune_intermediate_layers()`](../model_api#intermediate-features) | ✓ |
| [Any input size, no changes needed](../model_api#input-size) | ✗ |
| [`set_input_size()`](../model_api#input-size) | ✓ |
| [`dynamic_img_size=True`](../model_api#input-size) | ✗ |
| [`set_grad_checkpointing()`](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✓ |
| [Layer-wise LR decay (`group_matcher()`)](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✓ |
| [`reset_classifier()`](../model_api#classifier) | ✓ |

✓ supported, ✓ (square) works for square sizes only, ✗ not supported, – not needed (the model already accepts any input
size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`MaxxVit` with `maxvit_pico_rw_256` at 256),
other architectures of the same class are expected to behave the same. See the [Model API](../model_api) page for
details.
